clock_basis: cycles only; no physical clock verified
latency_convention: delivery edge minus accepted injection edge; cohort accepted during phase 1, including drain completions
offered_definition: cycles presenting valid at injection; repeated stalled presentations count
fairness_definition: Jain index across four source service counts during measurement; unequal eligibility may bias
occupancy_definition: pre-edge samples across 12 active input FIFOs
